about: Red cells of tools/scenarios today: every one is expected to stay red until the board is fixed, and fails the test if it turns green or changes. cells[case]["subject.field"] = [result, what the truth wants, what the board shows, reason id]. X-DEBATE.text: A still-running foreground `codex exec` sits in no debate yet: its CommandExecution (with `-o`) is written only when the process ends, so its report path is not known until then (the plan's limit: JS is not interpreted).
